les: Hoog en laag in dieselfde familie
kaps_punt: Onderwerp 4 - Waardeer en nadenke, Kwartaal 3. Die uitdrukkingskwaliteite van slaginstrumente in ŉ Afrika-musiekstuk. Klassifiseer verskeie instrumente as deel van ŉ familie of groep in terme van voorkoms, benoeming, hoe die klank voortgebring word en die toonhoogte klassifikasie (hoog-laag). Eie en ander se optredes en prosesse deur die gebruik van eenvoudige skeppende kunsterminologie.

items.bewering: 'n Fluitjie klink hoog, en 'n groot trom klink laag.
items.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
items.bron: University of Rochester PHY103, Drums (pas.rochester.edu/~sybenzvi/courses/phy103/2016f/phy103_drums.pdf): membrane frequency falls as diameter grows; a whistle is a standard high-pitch example in the CAPS-aligned pitch material (Carleton SERC 'Exploring Sound: Length Makes a Difference').

items.bewering: toonhoogte is hoe hoog of hoe laag 'n klank is. Volume is iets anders: dit is hoe hard of hoe sag 'n klank is.
items.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Timbre' (ASA definition 12.09 treats pitch and loudness as separate attributes); Carleton SERC 'Exploring Sound' (pitch = high/low; loudness a separate variable).

items.bewering: Jy kan die trom sag slaan, en sy klank bly laag.
items.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
items.bron: Ruler/pitch classroom sources (Carleton SERC; GVSU sound activity): striking harder makes a sound louder, not higher; pitch set by the vibrating object.

items.bewering: Hoog of laag is die vierde van vier ewe goeie vrae waarmee jy instrumente sorteer.
items.blok: Hoog en laag, hard en sag
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6 (English), Gr 4 Term 3 Topic 4, p. 35: 'Classify several instruments as part of a family or group in terms of appearance, name, how the sound is produced and pitch (high-low)' - pitch is the fourth of four. 'Ewe goeie' is a teaching judgement, not a fact claim.

items.bewering: By 'n trom is dit die vel wat vibreer en die klank maak.
items.blok: Hoekom die een trom laer klink as die ander
items.bron: University of Rochester PHY103, Drums; AIP Physics Today membrane-mode article (aip.brightspotcdn.com/PTO.v45.i3.40_1.online.pdf).

items.bewering: 'n Groot vel oor 'n wye opening vibreer gewoonlik stadiger as 'n klein vel. Daarom klink 'n groot trom gewoonlik laer as 'n klein een.
items.blok: Hoekom die een trom laer klink as die ander
items.bron: AIP membrane formula f = (2.405/2πa)√(T/μ): frequency inversely proportional to radius; Kettledrum patent US4831912 ('diameter ... inversely proportional to the fundamental frequency'). 'Gewoonlik' is correctly hedged, since tension also matters.

items.bewering: Die maker kan dieselfde vel stywer of slapper trek. 'n Stywer vel klink hoër, en 'n slapper vel klink laer.
items.blok: Hoekom die een trom laer klink as die ander
items.bron: AIP membrane formula (f ∝ √T); University of Barcelona drum-tension study (diposit.ub.edu, 'tightening one lug usually translates in a raise of the pitch').

items.bewering: Baie Suid-Afrikaanse skole het 'n marimba met houtlatte in 'n ry.
items.bron: IOL Sunday Tribune 2025 (school bands in the 1 100-player marimba record attempt); Nova News 2026 (SA National Schools Marimba Competition grew to 41 bands); Daily Dispatch on Aqua Vista Primary marimba bands. 'Baie' is a loose quantifier, supported qualitatively, not by a national count.

items.bewering: Die lang latte klink laag, en die kort latte klink hoog.
items.bron: Carleton SERC 'Exploring Sound: Length Makes a Difference' ('the shorter the bar, the higher the sound'); Britannica summary 'xylophone'.

items.bewering: 'n liniaal wat oor 'n tafelrand uitsteek, [wys] ook dat 'n korter stuk hoër klink.
items.bron: Carleton SERC 'Exploring Sound'; GVSU sound activity; Alabama ALEX ruler lesson: shorter overhang gives a higher pitch. Analogy mapping to the marimba holds: same material, shorter vibrating length, faster vibration, higher pitch. It would break only across different materials, which the lesson does not compare.

items.bewering: In Natuurwetenskappe wys 'n liniaal wat oor 'n tafelrand uitsteek, ook ...
items.bron: DBE 2023/24 Annual Teaching Plan, NST Grade 4 (education.gov.za), Term 3: 'Energy and sound' sits in weeks 8-9 and its investigation names an elastic band, not a ruler. CAPS Life Skills says the order of topics within a term is not fixed.
items.regstelling: The physics is right; what cannot be settled is the claim that learners meet the ruler in Natural Sciences. The official plan names an elastic band, and the sound topic may come after this lesson in the term. Only a textbook could show whether a ruler is used, and I may not open one. Unless a person confirms it, the safe fix is to drop the 'In Natuurwetenskappe' framing and keep the ruler as a stand-alone example.

items.bewering: Die Chopi van suidelike Mosambiek speel hulle xilofone wat hulle timbila noem.
items.bron: UNESCO ICH 'Chopi Timbila' (00133): Chopi live 'mainly in the southern part of Inhambane province in southern Mozambique'; timbila are their wooden xylophones. Wikipedia 'Chopi people' agrees (Zavala, Inhambane).

items.bewering: Die Chopi speel hulle timbila in 'n orkes. Daardie instrumente is met opset in verskillende groottes gebou.
items.blok: Een groep van klein tot groot
items.bron: UNESCO ICH 'Chopi Timbila': orchestras of 'five to thirty wooden xylophones ... of varying sizes and ranges of pitch'.

items.bewering: Die klein chilanzane speel die hoogste klanke en die groot gulu die laagste.
items.blok: Een groep van klein tot groot
items.bron: ILAM catalogue, Rhodes University (ilamcommons.ru.ac.za / digitalarchives.ru.ac.za, Hugh Tracey recordings): 'Chilanzane (Treble) ... Gulu (Double Bass)'; Wikipedia 'Timbila': gulu is the bass, with 3-4 keys, played standing with heavy mallets and gourd resonators. No source gives physical dimensions; 'klein'/'groot' follows from the treble and double-bass roles and the bar-length physics above.

items.bewering: Tussen hulle in sit die sange, die doli en die debiinda.
items.blok: Een groep van klein tot groot
items.bron: ILAM catalogue: 'Sange (Alto), Doli (Tenor), Debiinda (Bass)', between Chilanzane (Treble) and Gulu (Double Bass). Spellings match ILAM; other sources spell them sanje/dole/dibinda and call the bass chikhulu or chinzumana. Wikipedia calls the dibinda a tenor, but every source puts it between the extremes, and the lesson does not order the three.

items.bewering: Saam is hulle 'n groep binne die familie van slaginstrumente, en saam dek hulle die reeks van hoog tot laag.
items.blok: Een groep van klein tot groot
items.bron: Britannica summary 'xylophone' ('Percussion instrument consisting of a set of tuned wooden bars that are struck with mallets'); ILAM recording note 'the complete range ... from high treble down to the double bass'.

items.bewering: Die ngoma, met sy beesvel oor 'n wye opening gespan, hoort aan die lae kant.
items.bron: RAI ERA, Venda Girls / Milayo 'Ngomani - by the drums' (era.anthropology.ac.uk): ngoma is the 'big bass drum', the largest of the three; World Musical Instrument Collection, Venda ngoma (wmic.net): ox-hide head pegged over a hemispherical body carved from solid wood.

items.bewering: Die hosho se klein sade ritsel skerp binne die kalbas.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Hosho (instrument)': dried gourds (mapudzi) usually filled with hota (Canna indica) seeds; Grinnell College musical instruments collection, 'Bira instruments'.

items.bewering: Die sand of klippies in ratels van gedroogde kokonne (kokonratels) rammel wanneer die danser beweeg.
items.bron: Brighton & Hove Museums 'Making Botswana: Makgabe' (mopane-worm cocoons 'filled with small stones'); wmic.net Zulu cocoon ankle rattles (moon-moth cocoons 'filled with sand or small stones'); Pitt Rivers Museum leg rattles (tied to dancers' lower legs). Some San examples use ostrich-eggshell fragments instead, but 'sand of klippies' is attested and does not claim to be exhaustive.

items.bewering: Die geskraapte bottel klink grof as jy oor sy riwwe skraap.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Unpitched percussion instrument' and 'Percussion instrument': scrapers (e.g. guiro) are played by scraping a ridged surface and give a rasping, indefinite-pitch sound.

items.bewering: Nie een van die laaste drie het 'n vaste plek tussen hoog en laag nie.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Unpitched percussion instrument': rattles and scrapers are classed as instruments of indefinite pitch. The three are the hosho, the cocoon rattles and the scraped bottle.

items.bewering: Elkeen van die timbila het hoë en lae klanke binne een instrument.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Timbila': the mbila has up to nineteen keys, the dibinda ten, and even the gulu three or four. Every instrument has several keys of different pitch.

items.bewering: 'n Groep tromme wat ewe styf gespan is, loop van klein na groot en van hoog na laag.
items.bron: AIP membrane formula: at equal tension and membrane, frequency is inversely proportional to radius. 'Ewe styf' correctly holds the second variable fixed.

items.bewering: Kwartaal 3 se drama het uit 'n stimulus gegroei. Julle het karakters gebou, liedjies gekies en 'n klankbaan gemaak.
items.blok: Praat oor julle eie en mekaar se optredes
items.bron: DBE CAPS Life Skills Gr 4-6, Gr 4 Term 3, p. 35: 'Building a drama from a stimulus: characters'; 'Relate character of the chosen songs to suit characters in the drama'; 'Sound pictures using instruments ... to create a soundtrack for the drama'.

items.bewering: 'n Trom en 'n marimba klink anders, al klink albei ewe hoog en ewe hard. Daardie verskil noem ons toonkleur.
items.blok: Praat oor julle eie en mekaar se optredes
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Timbre', quoting ASA Acoustical Terminology 12.09: the attribute by which two sounds 'having the same loudness and pitch' are judged dissimilar. CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'timbre'.

items.bewering: toonhoogte: Hoe hoog of hoe laag 'n klank is.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Timbre' / ASA (pitch as the high-low attribute); CAPS key term 'pitch (high-low)'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: volume: Hoe hard of hoe sag 'n klank is.
items.bron: Carleton SERC 'Exploring Sound' and Twinkl CAPS-aligned Gr 4 NST sound activity (volume = loud/soft). Read alone: true.

items.bewering: toonkleur: Wat twee instrumente anders laat klink, al klink hulle ewe hoog en hard.
items.bron: ASA definition 12.09 via Wikipedia 'Timbre'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: vibreer: Om baie vinnig heen en weer te beweeg.
items.bron: Dictionary.com 'vibrate': 'to move to and fro or up and down quickly and repeatedly'. Read alone: true for the sound sense this lesson uses.

items.bewering: slaginstrument: 'n Instrument wat klank maak as jy dit slaan, skud of skraap.
items.bron: Merriam-Webster 'percussion instrument': 'sounded by striking, shaking, or scraping'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: familie: 'n Groep instrumente wat saamgegroepeer word volgens die manier waarop hulle klank maak.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Percussion instrument' and Merriam-Webster: percussion is grouped by how sound is produced (struck, shaken, scraped); orchestral families divide on the same basis. Read alone: true. It is consistent with the study block's 'groep binne die familie van slaginstrumente'.

items.bewering: xilofoon: 'n Instrument met houtlatte wat jy met stokkies slaan.
items.bron: Britannica summary 'xylophone': 'tuned wooden bars that are struck with mallets'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: timbila: Die Chopi se xilofone, met 'n hol dop onder elke houtlat.
items.bron: UNESCO ICH 'Chopi Timbila': under each wooden slat a calabash resonator is fastened and sealed with beeswax; Wikipedia 'Timbila': masala-fruit shells or gourds as resonators. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: ngoma: Die grootste en diepste trom wat die VhaVenda gebruik, met beesvel oor uitgeholde hout.
items.bron: RAI ERA Venda 'Ngomani - by the drums': ngoma is the largest and is the bass drum, with thungwa (tenor) and mirumba (alto, smallest); wmic.net Venda ngoma: ox-hide head over a body 'carved out of solid wood'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: hosho: 'n Kalbasratel van Zimbabwe met sade binne, in pare geskud.
items.bron: Wikipedia 'Hosho (instrument)': Zimbabwean (Shona) gourd rattles containing hota seeds, usually played in pairs, one in each hand. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: karakter: Die mens, dier, ding of opgemaakte wese wat 'n speler in 'n drama voorstel.
items.bron: WCED ePortal 'Drama lesson activities Gr 4-6: Building a drama from a stimulus' (plot, character, location); CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'character'. A standard drama definition. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: postuur: Hoe iemand sy lyf hou terwyl hy sit, staan of beweeg.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'posture' (with 'Consider body language, posture and gesture'); the standard sense of posture as how the body is held. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: gebare: Bewegings van die lyf, soos die hande, kop of arms, wat iets sê.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'gesture'; Dictionary.com 'gesture' (a movement of the body, head, arms or hands expressing an idea or emotion). Read alone: true.

items.bewering: gesigsuitdrukking: Die manier waarop jou gesig wys hoe jy voel.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'facial expression'; the standard sense. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: emosie: 'n Gevoel wat vanself in jou opkom en weer wegraak.
items.bron: APA (adapted from the APA Dictionary of Psychology, apa.org): emotion is a reaction pattern that typically involves feeling; APA Handbook (Dess 2010, quoted on researchcatalogue.net): a 'relatively brief episode'. 'Vanself' reads as 'without your choosing', which fits, and 'weer wegraak' matches 'brief'. Read alone: true. It does not say an emotion has no cause.

items.bewering: rekwisiete: Die voorwerpe wat spelers in 'n drama gebruik, soos 'n hoed of 'n stok.
items.bron: CAPS Life Skills Gr 4 Term 3 resources, p. 35: 'Props such as cans, suitcases, hats, newspapers, balls'. CAPS names a hat as a prop itself. Theatre usage (LibreTexts 'Stage Properties') files worn hats as 'costume props', so the example is sound. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: ruggraat: Die ry klein beentjies wat in die middel van jou rug loop.
items.bron: Kenhub 'The vertebral column'; Elsevier anatomy: a column of 33 vertebrae running down the midline of the back. Read alone: true at Grade 4 simplification.

items.bewering: isolasie: Om een deel van die lyf alleen te beweeg terwyl die res stil bly.
items.bron: St. Olaf College Dance, 'Modern Dance Language' ('hold one part of the body still while moving another part'); CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 'Body part isolations'. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: do-so: Vyf note wat na mekaar al hoër klink: do, re, mi, fa en so.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 Topic 3: 'Recognise melodies in range of 5th using tonic solfa (doh to soh)'. Doh-ray-me-fah-soh are five rising degrees spanning a fifth. Read alone: true.

items.bewering: klankprent: 'n Prentjie of storie wat julle net met klanke vertel.
items.bron: CAPS Gr 4 Term 3 key term 'sound picture (soundscape)' and 'Sound pictures using instruments ... to create a soundtrack for the drama and to introduce characters'; Scootle soundscape activity (sounds that create an environment or atmosphere). Read alone: true.

opsomming: Every claim checks out except one: I could not confirm that learners meet the ruler-over-the-table-edge test in Natural Sciences (the official Grade 4 plan names an elastic band, and the sound topic may come later in the term), so a person should either confirm it or have the writer drop 'In Natuurwetenskappe' and keep the ruler as a stand-alone example.
